messages:
elaine-partners: Kickoff: need final artifacts for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listing for pilot. Owners for keys, metering schema, EULA clause, and packaging?

elaine-partners: Primary constraints: EU key residency, non-exportable keys, hourly metering windows, trial caps.

toby-aws-eng: I'll take AWS KMS (eu-west-1 & us-west-2). Will share CFN snippet + cross-account key policy.

nik-infra: I'll handle GCP CMEK samples and a service-account email. Will also draft the onboarding manifest field for trial_limits.

sara-legal: Draft EULA telemetry sentence: "We collect aggregated usage metrics for billing and quality; customers may opt out of non-essential telemetry via account settings. Logs retained 30 days; aggregated metrics 90 days; EU keys/logs kept in-region." Adding breach-notify clause.

michael-product: Packaging checklist noted. I'll produce 1-line, long copy (200w), feature bullets, and screenshot mocks.

ops-bot: ticket MARKET-999 created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/MARKET-999 - assignees: toby-aws-eng, nik-infra, sara-legal, michael-product.

elaine-partners: Action items recap: toby - CFN + key policy; nik - CMEK + manifest; sara - final EULA; michael - assets + copy. I'll request metering API creds from vendor and post here when received. Ping me with blockers.
